text:
./bootstrap
./configure
make "-j$(nproc)"

for fuzzer in $SRC/*_fuzzer.c; do
  fuzzer_basename=$(basename -s .c $fuzzer)

  $CC $CFLAGS \
      -I $SRC -Iinclude \
      -c $fuzzer -o $fuzzer_basename.o

  $CXX $CXXFLAGS \
      -std=c++11 \
      $fuzzer_basename.o \
      -o $OUT/$fuzzer_basename \
      $LIB_FUZZING_ENGINE \
      src/.libs/libyaml.a

dependency_reason: The API stores the supplied pointer and length as parser input.
Defines deletion of parsed and copied event objects.
The second parser pass follows completion of the first loop, while the jump goes directly to cleanup.
The parser operation supplies the event to the entry.
This is the emitter operation the entry must reach with the parsed event.
Shows that the later parser pass cannot provide an equivalent route after the jump to cleanup.
